subject: Television & Streaming
title: Black Mirror's British Pessimism
description: A quick win: understand Black Mirror's British Pessimism.

hook.text: Charlie Brooker created Black Mirror on Channel 4 in 2011.

buildup.text: The show's title refers to the black mirror of a phone screen when it's off.

discovery.text: Netflix acquired the show in 2015, giving it a global audience.

twist.text: Some Black Mirror plots came true. China's social credit system and deepfake technology mirrored specific episodes.

climax.text: Black Mirror's global success proved that Britain's tradition of dark, satirical television translates powerfully.

punchline.text: British pessimism about technology became the world's warning system.

quiz.question: What does the title 'Black Mirror' refer to?
options: The black reflective surface of a phone or screen when it's turned off
